title: Disclosure Block (Standard §4.6)
description: Decision Provenance Standard — the disclosure block. The five Standard §4.6.2 required fields are declaring_authority, ai_system_identity, jurisdictional_applicability, content_type_tag, generation_timestamp. The schema additionally carries disclosure_text_pointer and attached_at as permitted extra fields (serving §6.2.3 attachment-moment audit) plus optional mode_1_edge_case_flag, last_reviewed_at, disclosure_provenance. The schema describes the fields of the disclosure block defined in Standard §4.6.2. Whether Article 50, or any other disclosure law, applies to an artifact is for the deployer to determine. The schema does not satisfy, ensure, or certify any regulatory obligation.

full_name.description: Legal name as on employment record

employer.description: Legal entity employing the declaring authority

declaring_authority.description: The person who prepares the disclosure and the organization they act for (Standard §2.2.12, §4.6.2). Not the AI system; not the Charter.

model_card_pointer.description: URL or path to the operator's model card.

jurisdictional_applicability.description: Records where the artifact is intended to circulate. It is an input to the deployer's own determination of which laws apply, not that determination itself.

content_type_tag.description: Standard §4.6.2 field #4. Controlled vocabulary tagging the type of AI-generated content the disclosure block covers. `other` permits an open type with detail recorded out-of-band. Survives the §4.6.3 4-of-5 anonymization rule.

generation_timestamp.description: Standard §4.6.2 field #5. ISO 8601 timestamp of content GENERATION (the moment the AI produced the artifact) — distinct from `attached_at` (the moment the block attached to a Charter/record). Anchor for regulatory-state inquiry into when the artifact was produced. Survives the §4.6.3 4-of-5 anonymization rule.

mode_1_edge_case_flag.description: True when the Charter is Mode 1 but a specific decision embeds an AI-generated summary. False otherwise. Structural trigger for per-decision-record disclosure attachment in the Mode 1 edge case.

disclosure_text_pointer.description: Reference to the actual disclosure text the declaring authority approved. The schema does not generate disclosure text; it points to text the declaring authority signed off on.

attached_at.description: When the disclosure block attached to the Charter or decision record (ISO 8601 UTC).

last_reviewed_at.description: When the declaring authority last reviewed and reaffirmed the disclosure. One way to show the block was reviewed within the Charter's cadence (Standard §7.4.1).

disclosure_provenance.description: Audit-ready provenance for the disclosure decision itself.
